answers.q1: Yarn classic (yarn@1.22.22, set in package.json) with Yarn workspaces. Node >=18 is required, and CI uses Node 20. Install with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:app --watch=false   (CI runs this as `yarn test:app`. `yarn test` is an alias for it, and plain vitest starts in watch mode. The broader `yarn test:all` also runs typecheck, eslint and prettier.)
answers.q4: yarn install && yarn test:other && yarn test:code && yarn test:typecheck   (test:other = prettier --list-different on css/scss/json/md/html/yml; test:code = eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .; test:typecheck = tsc. To auto-fix, run: yarn fix)
answers.q5: yarn.lock and dev-docs/yarn.lock (lockfiles). Build and generated output: node_modules/, build/, dist/, dev-dist/, coverage/, public/workbox, packages/excalidraw/types, examples/**/public. Vendored or binary assets under packages/excalidraw/subset/ (harfbuzz and woff2 wasm) and packages/excalidraw/fonts/ (font binaries). I did not inspect the contents of these two directories closely. Translations in packages/excalidraw/locales/*.json other than en.json are managed through Crowdin (crowdin.yml). Edit only en.json by hand.

q1.reason: Yarn classic with `yarn install` from root matches the accept criterion.

q2.reason: `yarn test:app --watch=false` is an explicitly accepted one-shot form, with correct notes on CI and test:all.

q3.reason: `yarn vitest run packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` exactly matches an accepted command.

q4.reason: Gives yarn test:other, test:code and test:typecheck matching CI; the fix mention is only supplementary.

q5.reason: Names yarn.lock, build output dirs (build/, dist/, dev-dist/) and non-en locale files managed by Crowdin; extras like subset/fonts are hedged and harmless.
